_comment: Merge into .cursor/mcp.json (project) or ~/.cursor/mcp.json (global). No clone and no absolute paths — npx fetches the published package, and Node >= 20.11 is the only prerequisite. --standalone = detached: submit_review returns the URL immediately (Cursor cancels MCP calls after ~5 minutes, so the tool must not block on the human review). Swap @latest for a pinned version (e.g. review-buddy@0.4.0) if you want reproducible startups.
